front.title: OctaTouch Gesture Runtime: Smoke-Test Behavior Profile

abstract.t: This document records five expected behaviors asserted by a supplied OctaTouch gesture-runtime smoke-test script. It is a limited test profile, not a complete gesture specification. The runtime implementation and its dependencies were not included with the source script, so the tests have not been executed as part of this archive. No interoperability or implementation-conformance claim is made.
